verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own automation through impact metrics and release management: safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold, and milestone progression that advances automatically while monitoring application health. This is real threshold-triggered automation, but it is limited to rollout safeguards rather than general user-defined event→action rules. Missing for 10: general-purpose event-triggered rules beyond metric thresholds on rollouts, a documented range of event sources and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
